summary: [BE] LAMOS LOS SME - Bucket Agunan - Data Agunan > Edit Agunan/Collaterals, Soft Delete Data Existing
description:
User Story
 :
Sebagai User AO saya ingin dapat menghapus Agunan yang sudah saya input karena kesalahan yang saya lakukan
Scope 
: 
- Munculkan Menu / Fungsi untuk hapus agunan
- Pop up Screen untuk memastikan agunan yang dipilih akan dihapus
- Service untuk melakukan hapus agunan terpilih
- Flagging Untuk Agunan-agunan yang dihapus
Acceptance Criteria : 
Requirement
Acceptance Criteria
Mockup
View available action menu options for a collateral record
Given 
the Account Officer is on the "Collateral Summary" page 
When 
the Account Officer clicks on the "Titik 3" (three-dot context menu) icon on a specific collateral object 
Then 
the system must display a dropdown list with exactly three options:
- Lihat Details
- Edit Agunan
- Hapus Agunan
Choose Hapus Agunan
When 
the Account Officer clicks on “Hapus Agunan” 
Then 
wil show pop up modals that ask the user that he really wants to delete this record : 
- When 
the Account Officer clicks the "Hapus" button 
Then 
the system must execute a "Soft Delete" by updating the record status to inactive in the database 
And 
the system must not permanently erase the data row from the system backend 
And 
the system must close the pop-up modal 
And 
the refreshed Collateral Summary page must no longer display the deleted collateral object
- When 
the Account Officer clicks the "Batalkan" button 
Then 
the system must close the pop-up modal immediately 
And 
the system must make no changes to the database 
And 
the collateral object must remain visible and unchanged on the Collateral Summary page
